name: 68601 · Columbus, NE
findings: ZIP 68601 (Columbus) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68601 (Columbus) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 68601 (Columbus) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
